newsitem.title: USA: FSA qualifies 10 muni issues for bond insurance.
newsitem.headline: FSA qualifies 10 muni issues for bond insurance.

text.p: Financial Security Assurance said Tuesday it qualified for bond insurance the following 10 municipal issues scheduled for competitive sale today:
--Grant County, Ind., $4.85 million general obligation bonds.
--Boone, N.C., $1.325 million GO and refunding bonds.
--Maurice River Board of Education, N.J., $2.995 million school bonds.
--Readington Township Board of Education, N.J., $12 million school bonds.
--Cobleskill-Rich Central School District, N.Y., $4.7 million GOs.
--Frankfort Central School District, N.Y., $1.618 million school bonds.
--New York State Bridge Authority, $49.22 million revenue bonds.
--North Colonie Central School District, N.Y., $2.223 million school bonds.
